role: Original illustrated terrain background; interactive landmarks and all five growth stages are rendered separately in shared/toenow-island.js.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story, game environment asset. Create an original premium illustrated OVERWORLD ISLAND MAP BACKGROUND for a browser cognitive adventure game. Landscape 3:2, orthographic almost top-down slightly isometric cozy hand-painted game art, like a beautifully designed illustrated atlas. No words, no lettering, no numerals, no UI, no pins, NO BUILDINGS: actual interactive landmarks and labels will be added by code on top. One SINGLE broad contiguous lush island filling nearly the whole image, only a modest border of calm turquoise sea around it. Land footprint from 5% to 95% horizontal and 7% to 94% vertical. Beautiful layered pale sand coastline, jade shallow water, gentle white foam, forested hills toward the top, a small lake on the middle-right, a stream flowing to the lower coast with one small footbridge, curved beige walking trails. Rich but restrained sage, moss and teal foliage, warm sandy earth, lavender-blue rocky mountain toward top middle, tiny flowers in soft muted colors, a small wooden arrival dock at far bottom-left coast. Ensure VERY LARGE open grass/earth clearings at these approximate positions to host clickable buildings: (18%,72%), (40%,72%), (75%,58%), (24%,45%), (59%,79%), (75%,26%), (52%,48%), (17%,23%), (44%,22%), (83%,80%). These ten clearings should be smooth quiet terrain with no prepainted foundations, rings, markers or numbered signs. Connect the clearings with natural winding pathways, no rigid grid. Thick green land must underlie all ten locations, do NOT make the island narrow. The style is thoughtful, charming and sophisticated rather than childish; tactile painterly terrain with soft ambient daylight and gentle shadows, crisp enough for an interactive map with clear silhouettes. Dense decorative trees concentrated between the clearings and near the coastline, keep each clearing open. Full bleed landscape background, no border frame, no empty white outer canvas, no globe, no floating island in outer space. Absolutely no castles, houses, domes, towers or game UI because those are overlaid separately.
